question: Should OpenClaw accept `openai/codex-action` v1.11's GitHub-hosted Linux user-namespace/AppArmor setup in jobs that supply OpenAI API credentials?
rationale: The action revision intentionally adjusts runner-level sandbox prerequisites before privilege reduction; this is a trust-boundary choice that cannot be resolved from the Dependabot diff alone, and repository policy requires direct sibling Codex inspection before a Codex verdict.

options.title: Approve after local action/runtime audit
options.body: Inspect the v1.11 action and matching local Codex runtime behavior, then rebase this PR and require the affected credentialed workflows to pass.
